_howto: Newest first. Add one item per release milestone (pre-order opens, out now, chart news). image is optional.

news.title: As We Live: Traxsource exclusive pre-order opens
news.text: Danny Deleon and Morris Revy's Soulful House single lands on Traxsource two weeks before everywhere else.

news.title: Free downloads: Shine, Tempus Fugit, Dancing in The Light
news.text: Three Danny Deleon records, free for fans. Drop your email and the MP3 is yours.

news.title: Pre-save As We Live, out Nov 6
news.text: Save it now and it drops into your library on release day.

news.title: NOFKS joins the label with NONE AT ALL
news.text: A new name on the roster. Out now on Beatport and Traxsource.

news.title: Shine (Richie Dio Remix) hits #9 in Afro House
news.text: Precious James and Danny Deleon's Shine, reworked by Richie Dio, reached #9 in Afro House and #83 overall on Traxsource during pre-order.
